children: stock price jumped about 16% on Wednesday during premarket hours after the company received FDA clearance for its TriNav Advance device.

to add TriNav Advance to its portfolio of devices designed to deliver cancer treatments directly to tumors. The company said the new device is particularly aimed at procedures involving smaller blood vessels that can be difficult for doctors to reach.
The company plans to begin a limited market release of TriNav Advance in the coming weeks.

The FDA clearance adds to TriSalus’ commercial device portfolio as the company seeks to expand adoption of its PEDD (Pressure-Enabled Drug Delivery) technology. The firm currently has three FDA-cleared devices using the technology.
